items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: So the Speed Webb band had Jonesey on one trumpet, Roy Eldridge on the other, Vic Dickenson on one trombone and my brother on the other trombone

ctx.x: So the Speed Webb band had Jonesey on one trumpet, Roy Eldridge on the other, Vic Dickenson on one trombone and my brother on the other trombone -- and that was the brass section, two trumpets and two trombones, until later on, we finally found an excellent trumpet player from Louisville who had modeled his mute playing after the great Joe Smith of those days, and played sweet solos in the mute --a guy named Steve Dunn. And that made the brass section.
By the way, do you remember who the drummer was?
